scope: Original27+extra12 exact-SKU product previews; all remain partial. Port counts refer to modeled sockets, not a declaration that missing geometry does not exist on the physical device.
method: Each visual socket lists its local mouth, outward normal and transformed pin-width axis. Exact SKU source photograph/drawing citations remain separate from generic insert dimensions.
Only entries with allowConnections=true and an explicit four-pin order can draw a cable. Others are visible-port previews only. No inherited default wire order accepted.
Plastic housing color is a photo-informed approximate display value, independent from shell recoloring and metal/inner-cavity materials.
Native manufacturer USB/BTB surfaces are listed separately from estimated socket inserts. Missing ports are explicit gaps.
Visual close-ups cannot establish electrical routing, current limits, mating tolerances or waterproofing.
